write_up: Your resume points toward Staff Accountant and Accounts Payable Specialist roles. A recruiter can follow your move from senior accounting in Vietnam to bookkeeping and payables in Houston, and would likely move it forward with a few questions about your part in the work.

Your strongest line is the month-end close at Minh Phat Trading Company: it gives the starting and ending times and names the checklist and template you made. Your current role also gives a useful picture of your workload, with around 400 vendor invoices a month in QuickBooks.

Let's start with what you helped the controller do at month end, then add what your junior accountants handled and your part in the audit. Those details can connect your US payables work with the broader accounting experience you're bringing to your next role.
